test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will make it logically complete.

HLO _ J _ OC LL _ E _ LOG P _ OI
solution:
**Given :** HLO _ J _ OC LL _ E _ LOG P _ OI

By checking options :

 
• AONEL → HLO __A__ J __O__ OC LL __N__ E __E__ LOG P __L__ OI → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ALONL → HLO __**A**__ J __**L**__ OC LL __**O**__ E __**N**__ LOG P __**L**__ OI → (It follows the pattern of : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/166d22bde532723e4e9b829ed85c9c992691ae4950fb35f268611cce82388f36.png] 
 
• BGHPN → HLO __B__ J __G__ OC LL __H__ E __P__ LOG P __N__ OI → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• BLOEN → HLO __B__ J __L__ OC LL __O__ E __E__ LOG P __N__ OI → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "**ALONL**" is the correct answer.
